title: Mirowski Marcin
name: Mirowski Marcin
description: composer. Born on 29 July 1976 in Częstochowa, he started to study the piano with Jadwiga Guziak at the School of Music in Radomsko. He went on to study at the Secondary School of Music in Częstochowa with Iwona Czarny. In 1996-2001 he studied composition with Professor Grażyna Pstrokońska-Nawratil at the Karol Lipiński Academy of Music in Wrocław. In 1998 he participated in the Socrates - Erasmus student exchange programme, which allowed him to study in Enschede, the Netherlands and take part in the workshops of contemporary composition in Stuttgart.Ever since he started studying at the Academy, he was interested in theatre and film music. His teacher of the art was Professor Zbigniew Karnecki. He may boast many awards and distinctions, including the third and the first prize of the Composition Competition in Tarnów (1993, 1994); second prize of the Tadeusz Baird Composition Competition for Young Composers in Warsaw (1996); first prize of the 1st Competition of the Academy of Music in Wrocław (1997). His score for Jak Matołusz poszedł szukać olbrzyma by T. Dorst and U. Ehler won a prize of the Polish National Festival of Puppet Theatres in Opole (2003), while the score for Córka Króla Mórz by Ż. Karasińska-Fluks received a prize of the International Festival of Puppet Theatres in Toruń (2003). He also won Złota Maska 2012 (Golden Mask 2012) for the score for Psiakość . Musical o zwierzęcej miłości and Konik Garbusek . Both productions have been put on at the Opole Puppet and Actor Theatre. In 2003-06 Marcin Mirowski was the music manager of the Wrocław Puppet Theatre. In May 2007 he founded the Film Harmony Orchestra. Mirowski was a composer-in-residence of the Lublin Philharmonic. updated: 2014 (Maria Kominek-Karolak)
